main_text.l: Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁדַד[?]
ישׁה mutuabit, fut. Hiph. 3 f. m. R. נָשָׁה[?]
ישׁוּב revertetur, pro ישׁוּב fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שׁוּב
ישׁוּב reverti faciet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. שׁוּב
ישׁוּד vastabit, pro ישׁוּד fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שָׁדַד[?]
ישׁוּת æquabit, ישׁוּ æquabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. f. & fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שׁוּה[?]
ישׁוּחֶה eloquetur, fut. Piel, 3. sing. masc. Rad. שׁוּחַ[?]
ישׁוּך mordebit, pro ישׁוּך fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁךְ
ישׁוֹם ponet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. שׂוּם[?]
ישׁוֹם obstupescet, pro ישׁוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. Rad. שָׁמַם[?]
לִישֹׁן[?] dormiendo. Eccles.
ʒ. ıı. Infin. Kal, præf. R. יָשֵׁן[?]
ישׁיע vociferabitur, ישׁיעוּ vociferabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. sing. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁוַע[?]
ישׁועתה omnimoda salus, est No. cum duplici signo fæm. à ישׁועה salus, R. ישׁע
ישׁועתך salus tua, ישׁועתה ejus, ישׁועות salutes, sing. fæm. constr. aff. & pl. fæm. No. ישׁועה, Rad ישׁע
ישׁוּף conteret, ישׁופך conteret te, ישׁופנו conteret eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּף[?]
ישׁור contemplabitur, ישׁורנו eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁור
ישׁור contemplabitur, pro ישׁור, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שׁור
ישׁחה incurvabit se, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. à R. שְׁחָה[?]
וישׁחה et incurvatus est,

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and several root forms are hard to read at this resolution and are marked [?]. The first line of the left column and the Hebrew forms of the right column are the least certain. The left running head and page number are faint: the left page number could not be read and is marked [?]. The "ʒ. ıı." before "Infin." is a doubtful printed marker. The catchword and signature are as printed at the foot. The line "et incurvatus est," ends the column; its final Hebrew word is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
